source.citation: Made-up conversation written for tests. Not real call data.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi there, what can I do for you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My promo code is not working and I only got it 3 days ago.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Could I have your full name please?

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Tomas Reyes.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Membership level of guest has been noted.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem, guests can always get a replacement code.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A promo code has been created.

note: The agent's answer contradicts the ABCD guideline (guests cannot get a replacement code). Used for repeated-wrong-answer and conflict tests.
